notes.title: Reinforcements Update is HERE!
notes.content:
Welcome Defenders! After a long time I'm coming back to you with great news, a brand NEW UPDATE!

[h2]Augments[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/e58cb580021ea82c715aff601ce8edcafeeccf49.png[/img]
Augments are a new progression system that grants powerful abilities! Augment selection occurs every 20 waves, starting from wave 20, until no augments are left.

[h2]Defender of the Month[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/f89d4c69f99dd1d9bd191183714dab93ef3cf397.png[/img]
This panel, accessible from the main menu, displays your amazing statistics (yes, the stats have been collected from the very beginning, so you won’t miss anything!). This also marks the beginning of the badge system—you’ll have plenty of opportunities to earn them through various events and challenges in the future!

Currently, they are categorized into three types:
[list]
[*] Synergy
[*] Utilities
[*] Defensive
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Watcher Drone not to copy attributes correctly from the parent tower
[*] Fixed a notorious bug that made towers shoot across the map at the first enemy of the wave
[*] Fixed a bug where the Time Lock Malware Disk timer was not hidden when the [b]Hide HUD[/b] action was performed
[*] Fixed a bug that caused trails to apparently not work (lol)
[*] Fixed a bug where end screen summary buttons didn't work
[/list]

[h3]Minor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Laser Whip will no longer display the projectile count attribute, as it is irrelevant for it
[*] Hotstreak loss now happens immediately after taking damage instead of at the end of the wave
[*] Changed Laser Whip range indicator color to blue
[*] Added a Digital Archives button to the pause panel
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a keybind for sampling the tower under the mouse for faster building (default [b]Q[/b])
[*] Added automatic settings change detection to prompt the user for confirmation before exiting
[*] Added a scalable range indicator to minimize pixel size inconsistencies
[*] Added a warning message when using a luck-based module on a tower that has no luck (surprisingly, many people missed this)
[/list]

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 4 new achievements ([b]one hidden[/b])
[/list]

notes.title: Face the Challenge Update!
notes.content:
[h1]What's new in the Face the Challenge Update?[/h1]

[h2]Digital Archives[/h2]
Digital Archives is a collection of "articles" containing detailed information about towers, modules, systems, and the world of Defendron. And much more!
Not sure at which level a specific tower gets an additional module slot?
Check the archives!
Don't know which towers a particular module is compatible with?
Check the archives!

I had the idea for the Digital Archives over a year ago, but at the time, there wasn't enough time to fill them with content. As the number of systems, towers, and modules grew so quickly, writing something that would soon become obsolete felt inefficient. Now that Defendron is well-established and has the form it should, the time has come to revisit the idea and finally implement it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/42a5f5c441f2c03b5ad54fab361af7f17b028164.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/58d51083c9d6ed41917362a7b05920d514061e5e.png[/img]

[h2]New Towers[/h2]
This update introduces 6 new towers, which expand the defender arsenal in an intriguing way. I'll leave the details of how they work for you to discover once the update is 100% ready, but I can assure you they bring a breath of fresh air and may prove to be very useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/7d3a7adc5227d31899bd3e0585f3f5ba3549347d.png[/img]

[h2]Revamped SDD Disks[/h2]
Upgrade disks have also received the attention they deserve. A much more interesting approach is the new tree structure, which grants access to all unlocked disks at once, after reaching a certain star threshold. Limiting the player to just one disk, as was the case before, wasn't satisfying or engaging enough to warrant much focus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/e4f4aa05b43acdb84d24501b0933fd5816d6d4c6.png[/img]

[h2]Malware Disks[/h2]
Malware disks are the centerpiece of this update, designed to offer players new challenges when they feel the game is too easy. Each disk increases the threat level, which acts as a score multiplier at the end of a level, while generously rewarding your efforts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/261f5710b35c079afd061686f08a488b7a1c2897.png[/img]

[h2]New Progression[/h2]
The game's progression has been completely refreshed.
First and foremost, the act unlocking system has been changed – now acts 2-5 unlock after completing the first one. This is intended to encourage players to choose their own path while progressing through the game.
I also focused on unlocking towers, ensuring that the rewards are appropriate for the floor they originate from. Additionally, when selecting levels where a new tower is the reward, I placed them at the beginning of each act. This way, players have the chance to at least try the first level of every act.
Key systems like the module workshop, upgrade disks, and malware disks have been introduced gradually, so as not to overwhelm the player. This gives them time to grasp these new mechanics before fully understanding how to use them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/50ba01e8f3f6d55810ede39a570e3d04957bcc8f.png[/img]

[h2]Revamped End Screen[/h2]
The end screen has received a new visual design and now also provides players with information about which towers and modules dealt how much damage. I drew this inspiration after several hours of playing Vampire Survivors and Death Must Die (by the way, these are amazing games—definitely give them a try!), where I realized that this information is incredibly useful for evaluating what’s strong and what’s not. Besides, who doesn’t love big numbers?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/a492171961dc47e83d96e72faa6289e0edcb9442.png[/img]

[h1]And much more![/h1]
I plan to release an update for Halloween and you can expect something special for the occasion!

*Images for illustration purposes only, systems may look different in the final version of the update!*

notes.title: Defendron v2.0 City of Tomorrow Update!
notes.content:
Welcome Defenders!

After a long wait, we are thrilled to announce a game that is at least [b]THREE TIMES[/b] bigger than our last update (in content, not file size lol).

We have worked tirelessly for months to bring you the Defendron we always envisioned.

We hope that player who were previously discouraged will rediscover the joy and excitement in the brand-new Defendron.

Without further ado, let's dive into the changes!

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
The update primarily focuses on the core characteristics and uniqueness of Defendron.

We have introduced many new modules that not only enhance the towers but also work together to create vast number of combinations and strategies for you to explore!

We have also added all acts and levels, bringing the total to 25 unique levels with various challenges and layouts.

This is not the end of Defendron's development, as we have countless new ideas that will make the game even better!

[b]Stay tuned for more information about our future goals![/b]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]Acts[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Added all 5 acts, each with unique challenges, environmental hazards, and visuals:
    [list]
        [*] Topside Takedown
        [*] Digital Domain
        [*] Neon Nightscape
        [*] Steel Shakedown
        [*] Toxic Wastes[/list][/list]
[h3]Towers[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Changed tower unlock progression
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Added endless mode with infinite scaling
    [*] Added 13 new boss sprites
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/c0e493ac1e1c777a4e7a9bf30dc2af794d2786bc.png[/img]
[h3]Tower Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Rebalanced towers
    [list]
        [*] Increased Ion Blaster base damage
        [*] Increased Plasma Emitter base damage
        [*] Decreased Skywatcher max level module sockets count
        [*] Decreased Laser Whip base damage
        [*] Decreased Plasma Emitter max damage
        [*] Capped Chrono Trap slow percent to 65%
        [*] Changed Plasma Emitter default targeting option to First
        [*] Essence Replenisher can add additional buff when replenishing based on luck[/list]
    [*] Added a new Omnitron tower: A tower focused on modules slots, allowing you to experiment and play with different module combinations
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/c57d398ca86bac2161107bab3f910b43a12a420f.png[/img]
[h3]Modules System[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Added 30+ new modules
    [*] Completely revamped the modules system
    [*] Some modules are dependent on luck
    [*] Added 4 new module combinations:
    [list]
        [*] Trail modules
        [*] Aura modules
        [*] Infusion modules
        [*] On-hit modules[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/0776b1646511e5acfe8a8a141b7b655b8e66ea68.png[/img]
[h3]Modules Workshop[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Addes modules workshop with reforging, disassembling and upgrading modules:
    [list]
        [*] Reforging a module will grant a new one with the same rarity
        [*] Disassembling module grants two lower rarity modules (Common modules cannot be disassembled)
        [*] Upgrading two modules of the same rarity modules will grant a higher rarity module (up to Mythic rarity, only obtainable by upgrading)[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/b7b9cc0986d01a14224768d9e855e01315356d5f.png[/img]
[h3]Level Selection[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Improved level cards:
    [list]
        [*] Added a statistics ribbon
        [*] Added a rewards ribbon
        [*] Added level statistics[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413063/17d370ad38f2305ec9ea6b9418a3322d3c35fc30.png[/img]
[h3]Quality of life[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Added an inventory panel displaying all currently unequipped modules with a count beside the backpack icon
    [*] Added an option to target only certain path colors in levels with multiple paths
    [*] Added accessibility option to turn off Defen tips
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Changed the save file extension with backward compatibility
    [*] Fixed many localisation bugs
    [*] Fixed bug with Essence Replenisher adding debuffs to nearby towers when replenishing
[/list]

notes.title: Free Major Content Update! Environmental Hazarads Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome Defenders![/h1]
We haven't heard from each other for a long time, but I'm coming to you with an amazing update that I've been working on all this time. It was definitely not easy to find time between holidays and university classes, but despite everything, I tried with all my heart to improve Defendron every day. Without further ado, let's get into the changes!

notes.title: Patch #1 Cheating Plasma Emitter and Ui stuck
notes.content:
We came across a notorious bug regarding the UI. Additionally, the Plasma Emitter attempted to cheat a little by targeting enemies inside tunnels!

We have successfully resolved both issues, and now your gameplay experience should be much smoother!

Happy defending!
